citations.assessment: The Bavli has Yoḥanan in the name of R. Menaḥem Yodfa’ah regarding the Torah status of the water libation.
The parallel spells the epithet Yodafa and has the same reporting direction. The sage is bare in this witness.
The commentary uses the Yodfa’ah form in explaining the roles of Resh Lakish and Menaḥem.
This parallel uses the Yotfiyah form and has Yose son of Ḥanina as transmitter, preserving the distinct Yerushalmi chain.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
